title: Cosmic Witch and Shadow
description: A surreal cosmic scene featuring a dark-skinned woman with long silver hair and glowing golden eyes, her body adorned with stars and wrapped in a turquoise serpent. To her right stands a large blue furry monster, a black devil silhouette, a wizard in a blue robe raising his hand toward a swirling galaxy portal, cherry blossom branches, black ravens, and a checkered floor with a lotus lamp and ribs.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene with a dark-skinned cosmic witch with long flowing silver hair and glowing golden eyes, her body covered in stars and wrapped by a giant turquoise serpent with spiral patterns. She stands beside a large blue furry monster resembling Sully, a solid black devil silhouette, and a wizard in a patterned blue robe reaching toward a swirling purple galaxy portal in the sky. Cherry blossom branches with black ravens, checkered floor, lotus lamp, and ribs in foreground, mystical night atmosphere with full moon.
